summary: Iteration 87: Tested Social Proof Banner, Conversion Optimization, AI Assistant affiliate CTAs, and Must-See CTAs. All core features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: SocialProofBanner.js correctly fetches /api/homepage/main-journey and displays last 3 contributors with display_name, amount, created_at
Social Proof 'Junta-te a eles' CTA correctly links to /journey/{journey_id}
Final Conversion Block has 'Contribuir para o sonho' as dominant full-width CTA with pulse animation
Secondary 'ou cria o teu roteiro' is visually minimized (text-white/50, text-xs)
Ambassador messaging correctly shows 'Sabias que podes abrir a tua própria viagem de sonho?' + 'Descobre como te tornares Embaixador'
AI Assistant affiliate CTAs use dark bg (bg-[#2D2A26]) with 'Ver opções de alojamento' and 'Ver opções' text
AI Assistant keyword matching includes: hotel/alojamento/hostel/quarto/dormir + bilhete/experiência/atividade/fila/museu/tour/visita
Must-see CTAs use dark bg (bg-[#2D2A26]) with 'Evita filas' text
Mid Journey Progress Banner shows 'Viagem de sonho da 4Luis a {destination}' + 'Ajuda a concretizar este sonho'
/api/homepage/main-journey returns contributions array with display_name, amount, created_at (verified with 2 real contributors)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing China journey (journey_china001) and Roma template
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limiter is in-memory (3 req/hour anonymous). Use Roma destination for instant template-based plans. Admin user is NOT an ambassador (AI Assistant is gated). China journey (journey_china001) is at ~3% funded with 2 real contributors. Social Proof Banner fetches from same endpoint as JourneyProgressBanner.
